Source.evidence_source: ['010_outcome_measures', 'Children’s Depression Inventory (CDI) (Kovacs, 1992) was used to assess youth self-reported depressive symptoms.', '010_outcome_measures', 'Children’s Global Assessment Scale (CGAS) (Shaffer et al., 1983) was used to assess youth functioning.', '010_outcome_measures', 'The Child Behavior Checklist (CBCL) (Achenbach & Edelbrock, 1983) and Teacher’s Report Form (TRF) (Achenbach & Edelbrock, 1986) were used to assess youth behavior problems. The Youth Self-Report (YSR) (Achenbach & Edelbrock, 1987) was used to assess youth self-reported behavior problems.', '010_outcome_measures', 'The Family Environment Scale (FES) (Moos & Moos, 1981), Parent-Child Relationship Inventory (PCRI) (Gerard, 1994), and Parenting Stress Index (PSI) (Abidin, 1995) were used to assess family functioning and parenting.', '010_outcome_measures', 'The Social Adjustment Scale for Children and Adolescents (SAS-CA) (Weissman et al., 1978) was used to assess youth social functioning.', '010_outcome_measures', 'The Piers-Harris Children’s Self-Concept Scale (PHCSCS) (Piers, 1984), Children’s Automatic Thoughts Questionnaire (CATQ) (Kazdin, 1990), Children’s Negative Cognitive Errors Questionnaire (CNCEQ) (Leitenberg et al., 1986), Children’s Attributional Style Questionnaire (CASQ) (Kaslow et al., 1984), Children’s Coping Strategies Checklist (CCSC) (Compas et al., 1988), and Children’s Hopelessness Scale (CHS) (Kazdin et al., 1986) were used to assess youth cognitive and coping styles.', '010_outcome_measures', 'The Children’s Depression Rating Scale-Revised (CDRS-R) (Poznanski et al., 1984), Global Assessment of Functioning (GAF) (American Psychiatric Association, 1994), and Clinical Global Impression-Severity (CGI-S) (Guy, 1976) were used to assess youth depressive symptoms and global functioning.']
